notes.en:
**Summary and General Analysis**

✦ When an enemy take damage from Burn DoT, Guiniafen has a chance to apply "Firekiss" to them which will apply Vulnerability to the affected enemy.

✦ Her Ultimate detonates any Burn DoT currently applied to enemies

**Noteable Investments**

E1, E4, E6

**Investment Explanation**

✦ Her E1 helps the team apply debuffs.

✦ Her E4 makes her Ultimate rotation more comfortabke.

✦ Her E6 provides more damage to the team.

**Ability Rotation**

Basic ATK spam, Skill if needed
